question_or_symptom: The CP-0002 verifier made SOURCE_LOCK both the immutable upstream authority and the exact current-head registry, which prevents authored lanes and audited descendant commits.
observation: SOURCE_LOCK must remain byte-identical to the accepted upstream freeze, while self-amdgpu-runtime has no upstream revision and future gem5/runtime/Triton changes necessarily move their gitlinks beyond baseline commits.
conclusion: Baseline provenance, project membership, and accepted current state are separate authorities with different mutation rules.
decision: Keep upstream baselines in immutable SOURCE_LOCK, keep project-authored baselines in PROJECT_LANES, and place exact current commit/tree identities only in checkpoints. Verify the exact union of both registries and require every current head to descend from its declared baseline.
invalidated_assumptions: A frozen upstream source manifest can also be the permanent membership and current-head database for a multi-repository implementation project.
